description: What a gated tool call puts on the MACP wire, and what the MCP caller gets back. Strings with {placeholders} are templates: substitute literally, no other formatting. {server} is gate.json's server, {tool} the tool name, {context_id} and {preimage} as in context-id-vectors.json, {gate} the gate's MACP_AGENT_ID, {threshold} the rule's effective threshold, {session_id} the approval session's id, {state} its SessionState name without the SESSION_STATE_ prefix (EXPIRED, CANCELLED), {runtime_message} the runtime's Ack failure message.

session_start.policy_version: rule.policy_version, or the runtime default when omitted

macp.mode.quorum.v1.ballots: The first Approve / Reject / Abstain from each approver for request_id {context_id} counts (the runtime rejects a second one); Approve is an approval.

macp.mode.decision.v1.participants: [{gate}] followed by rule.participants; the gate never votes and is not counted
macp.mode.decision.v1.ballots: The first Vote from each approver on proposal_id call counts (the runtime rejects a second one); APPROVE (case-insensitive) is an approval, REJECT and ABSTAIN are not.

commitment.reason: Free text; not part of the contract.
commitment.reported: The Commitment envelope the runtime records for the session (its payload bytes are what commitment_hash covers).

meta_value.commitment_hash: RFC-MACP-0013 hash of the recorded Commitment payload

forwarded_result.note: Added to the upstream's CallToolResult _meta; every key the upstream set is preserved. outcome is "approve" or "deny"; only forwarded calls carry the key, so it is always "approve" there.

refusals.note: The upstream is never called. The result is an MCP tool error (isError: true) whose only content is one text block with exactly the rendered template.

templates.denied: POLICY_DENIED: tool call {tool} denied by session {session_id}
templates.not_open: SESSION_NOT_OPEN: session {session_id} ended {state} without a commitment
templates.unsafe_integer: INVALID_ARGUMENT: tool call {tool} arguments contain an integer outside ±(2^53−1), which has no canonical JSON form

cases.denied: The session committed outcome_positive = false (the threshold became unreachable).
cases.policy_denied: The runtime rejected the gate's positive Commitment with POLICY_DENIED (a bound RFC-0012 policy); the gate cancels the session.
cases.not_open: The session ended EXPIRED or CANCELLED with no Commitment. A session still OPEN at ttl_ms + expiry_grace_ms is cancelled by the gate first, so {state} is CANCELLED there.
cases.unsafe_integer: The arguments hold a number that is integral with |v| > 2^53−1 (Python: an int, or a float with is_integer(); TypeScript: Number.isInteger(v) && !Number.isSafeInteger(v)), at any depth. Checked before any session is opened.
cases.other: Any other failure (runtime unreachable, a rejected SessionStart, ...) is "<CODE>: <message>" with the base server's code precedence: Ack failure code, then the macp-error-code trailer, then the gRPC status name. Not a template; codes and messages vary.
